name: Google Bard Integration
description: Integrates the (unofficial, cookie-authenticated) Google Bard chat endpoint into Drupal via a simple query form.
project_description:
Note: This module is deprecated in favour of Google Gemini Project ( https://gemini.google.com/faq ). Please use Google Gemini module for AI integration.

 The Google Bard Drupal module introduces a cutting-edge integration of Google's innovative Bard technology into your Drupal-powered websites. With this module, you can harness the power of Google's PaLM 2 model, a transformative AI breakthrough, to collaborate with generative AI right within the Drupal CMS environment.

 Just as Bard thrives on collaboration, we invite you to join the experiment by incorporating this Drupal module. Bard's integration comes with built-in safety controls and mechanisms for feedback, aligning with Google's AI principles. Please remember that Bard's responses, although creative and helpful, may not always be accurate. It's still an early-stage experiment, and your engagement will contribute to its evolution.

 Features 
 
 Deep integration with Drupal and Google Bard AI [Completed] 
 Quick installation by just download and enabling the module from administration backend [Completed] 
 Minimal configuration to introduce the Bard generative AI service [Completed] 
 Bard helps to use the service in content creation and content validation through Rich Text Editor (RTE) [TBD] 
 Content translation will be also possible using the service. [TBD]
